overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（2 篇）、公司金融（1 篇）。方法上以贝叶斯方法、双重差分为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、Semantic Scholar（5 篇）。其中 3 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Mechanism Design for Alignment and Control
papers.abstract: We develop a framework for mechanism design with AI agents whose alignment (preferences) and capabilities (feasible actions and information) are unknown. We want such agents to act on our behalf so mechanisms must incentivize both honesty and obedience. A one-sided imitation structure---capabilities can be concealed but not counterfeited---yields a revelation principle, a characterization of implementable policies via nested cyclical monotonicity, and conditions under which eliciting higher-order beliefs can discipline multiple agents. We apply our framework to stylized examples of (i) sandbagging in which a more capable agent pretends to be less capable; (ii) an alignment--interpretability trade-off, where the two are substitutes in the instrument but complements in value; (iii) discipline via peer scoring; (iv) coupling rewards to induce competition among multiple agents; and (v) scalable oversight and reward shaping.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们构建了一个用于机制设计的框架，该框架适用于那些其偏好（即行为目标）和能力（即可执行的行动及所掌握的信息）均未知的AI代理。我们希望这些代理能够代表我们行事，因此机制设计必须同时激励代理的诚实性和服从性。采用一种单向模仿机制——代理可以隐藏自己的能力，但无法伪造这些能力——可以揭示出某些关键原则：通过嵌套的循环单调性来描述可实施的策略，并明确在何种条件下能够引导代理形成更高层次的认知（即更复杂的信念），从而实现对多个代理的有效约束。我们将这一框架应用于以下几种典型场景：（i）“沙袋策略”（即能力更强的代理假装自己能力较弱）；（ii）偏好与可解释性之间的权衡（这两种属性在工具性层面是替代关系，但在价值层面则是互补关系）；（iii）通过同伴评分来实施约束；（iv）通过奖励机制激发多个代理之间的竞争；（v）实现可扩展的监督与奖励设计。。

papers.title: Bi-Compositional Division Rules
papers.abstract: We characterise the division rules for claims problems that satisfy equal treatment of equals, bilateral consistency, composition down, and composition up. The rules are precisely the members of a one-parameter log-exponential family $\{r^θ\}_{θ\in[-\infty,+\infty]}$, with constrained equal awards (CEA) and constrained equal losses (CEL) as its endpoints. For finite $θ$, $r^θ$ is the equal-sacrifice rule in awards for $u_θ=\log\varphi_θ$, where \[ \varphi_θ(x):=\frac{e^{θx}-1}θ\quad(θ\ne0), \qquad \varphi_0(x):=x, \] and simultaneously the equal-sacrifice rule in losses for the dual utility $u_{-θ}$. The proportional rule is the midpoint, $θ=0$. Continuity of the rules are not assumed but a consequence of the other axioms.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了满足“平等对待平等者”原则、双边一致性以及“向下组合”与“向上组合”性质的权利分配规则。这些规则具体属于一个单参数对数-指数族 $\{r^θ\}_{θ\in[-\infty,+\infty]}$，其端点分别为“受限平等赔偿”（CEA）和“受限平等损失”（CEL）情形。当参数 $\theta$ 为有限值时，$r^θ$ 表示在赔偿方面的“平等牺牲”规则，其中 $u_θ=\log\varphi_θ$，且满足 $\varphi_θ(x):=\frac{e^{θx}-1}θ\quad(θ\ne0)$，$\varphi_0(x):=x$；同时，它也对应于对偶效用 $u_{-θ}$ 在损失方面的“平等牺牲”规则。当 $\theta=0$ 时，该规则退化为“比例规则”。虽然并未明确假设这些规则的连续性，但这实际上是其他公理的自然推论。。

papers.title: Balancing Acts or Self‐Serving: The nexus Between Corporate Social Responsibility Decoupling and Tax Avoidance
papers.abstract: Recent studies highlighted the phenomenon of corporate social responsibility (CSR) decoupling, where firms' CSR disclosures diverge from their actual CSR performance. This study investigates the relationship between CSR decoupling and tax avoidance, offering a dual‐theoretical lens that integrates legitimacy theory and agency theory. From a legitimacy perspective, we argue that firms experiencing reputational deficits due to CSR decoupling may engage in tax avoidance to signal financial success and restore stakeholder confidence. From an agency standpoint, CSR decoupling exacerbates information asymmetry and weakens governance, enabling opportunistic managers to pursue aggressive tax strategies that enhance short‐term financial metrics. By embedding these theoretical perspectives, our study contributes to the literature by conceptualizing CSR decoupling not merely as a disclosure‐performance gap, but as a strategic condition that influences financial behaviour. Empirical analysis supports our propositions, revealing a positive association between CSR decoupling and tax avoidance. Mechanism testing further validates our framework, identifying poor firm performance, elevated agency costs, and heightened information opacity as key channels linking CSR decoupling to tax avoidance. We also explore contextual contingencies—such as institutional environments, tax enforcement intensity, industry characteristics, and leadership traits—that moderate this relationship. Our findings offer important implications for investors, regulators, and policymakers concerned with corporate transparency, governance, and ethical conduct.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】近期研究揭示了企业社会责任（CSR）脱节的现象，即企业的CSR披露与其实际CSR表现之间存在差异。本研究探讨了CSR脱节与避税行为之间的关系，并采用了结合合法性理论与代理理论的双重理论视角进行分析。从合法性角度来看，我们认为因CSR脱节而面临声誉问题的企业可能会通过避税来展示其财务实力并重塑利益相关者的信心；从代理理论的角度来看，CSR脱节加剧了信息不对称性并削弱了企业治理机制，使得机会主义管理者能够采取激进避税策略以提升短期财务指标。通过整合这两种理论视角，本研究将CSR脱节不仅仅视为披露与实际表现之间的差距，而将其视为一种影响企业财务行为的战略因素。实证分析支持了我们的观点，发现CSR脱节与避税行为之间存在正相关关系。机制分析进一步验证了我们的框架，指出企业绩效不佳、代理成本上升以及信息透明度降低是CSR脱节与避税行为之间的关键联系渠道。此外，我们还研究了制度环境、税收执法力度、行业特征及领导风格等情境因素对这种关系的调节作用。我们的研究结果对关注企业透明度、治理结构及道德行为的投资者、监管机构和政策制定者具有重要的启示意义。。

papers.title: Effectiveness Implementation of Monitoring and Evaluation of Regional Development Programs in the Development Administration Section of the Regional Secretariat Kampar Regency
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: Study This aim for analyze effectiveness implementation of monitoring and evaluation of development programs area in the Development Administration Section of the Kampar Regency Regional Secretariat and identify internal and external factors that influence it. Research use approach qualitative with type study descriptive. Data collection techniques are carried out through interviews, observations, and documentation. Data analysis using SWOT approach to know strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats in implementation of monitoring and evaluation development area. Research results show that implementation of monitoring and evaluation of development programs areas in Kampar Regency have walk Enough good. This is seen from level realization budget relative area​ tall as well as achievements SAKIP value is in the very high category. Monitoring and evaluation done in a way routine as form control development area. However Thus, its implementation Still face a number of obstacles, such as coordination and reporting between OPDs that are not optimal, limitations source Power humans, as well as utilization technology information that is still Not yet maximum. Besides that, the evaluation was carried out Still more focus on aspects administrative and absorption budget compared to impact of the program on society. The results of the SWOT analysis show that Kampar Regency has sufficient strength and opportunities​ big in increase effectiveness of monitoring and evaluation development area. Therefore that, is necessary strengthening coordination between device area, improvement capacity source Power humans, as well as development monitoring and evaluation system based technology information for implementation development area can walk more effective, transparent, and accountable.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】本研究旨在分析甘帕尔县区域秘书处发展管理部门在发展项目监测与评估方面的实施效果，并识别影响其实施效果的内部和外部因素。研究采用定性研究方法，具体为描述性研究。数据收集通过访谈、观察和文献资料等方式进行。数据分析运用SWOT分析法，以了解发展项目监测与评估工作在实施过程中的优势、劣势、机遇和威胁。

研究结果表明，甘帕尔县在发展项目监测与评估方面的实施情况总体良好。这体现在相关领域的预算执行水平较高，以及SAKIP（发展绩效评估体系）的评估结果处于非常高的类别。监测与评估工作已形成常规化机制，作为发展项目管理的重要环节。然而，实施过程中仍存在一些障碍，例如各相关部门之间的协调与报告机制不够完善、人力资源不足，以及信息技术应用尚未达到最佳水平。此外，评估工作更多侧重于行政管理和预算执行方面，而较少关注项目对社会产生的实际影响。

SWOT分析结果显示，甘帕尔县在提升发展项目监测与评估效果方面具备较强的优势和发展机遇。因此，有必要加强各部门之间的协调配合，提升人力资源能力，并改进基于信息技术的监测与评估体系，从而使发展项目监测与评估工作更加高效、透明和问责。。

papers.title: Freemium Model for Information Provision
papers.abstract: The paper explores a theoretical freemium model for the sale of information, drawing on mathematical tools used in the study of repeated zero-sum games and Bayesian persuasion. Unlike standard Bayesian persuasion models, the information seller (IS) is indifferent to the actions taken by the information buyer (IB) and is concerned solely with maximizing the revenue from selling information. Offering some information for free may increase the IB's willingness to pay for additional information.   The information that the IB seeks is about the state of the world. Initially, the IB only knows the prior distribution over possible states. The IS supplies both free and paid information through signals whose state-dependent distributions determine the IB's posterior via Bayes' rule. The IB's utility is a function of the posterior. An optimal free signal is one that maximizes the IS's expected revenue from the subsequent paid signal. That revenue is equal to the IB's expected utility gain when moving from the posterior induced by the free signal to that induced by the paid signal.   The paper characterizes the optimal free and paid signals and derives a formula for the maximal revenue in terms of the IB's utility function. It shows that a revenue gain for the IS from the provision of free information is accompanied by a loss to the IB.   Whether free information can increase the IS's revenue depends on the form of the IB's utility function. In the two-state case, that dependence is fully characterized. In the general case, only necessary conditions are obtained. In particular, if the IB's utility function is convex, the IS can never profit from providing free information. This occurs, in particular, when the IB uses the information to solve a decision problem. By contrast, when the IB is engaged in a strategic interaction with a third party, the IS may benefit from providing free information.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】本文探讨了一种用于信息销售的免费增值（freemium）理论模型，该模型借鉴了研究重复性零和博弈（repeated zero-sum games）及贝叶斯说服（Bayesian persuasion）时所使用的数学工具。与传统的贝叶斯说服模型不同，信息卖方（IS）对信息买方（IB）的行为并无偏好，其唯一目标是通过出售信息来实现收入最大化。提供部分免费信息可能会增加买方购买更多信息的意愿。买方所寻求的信息涉及世界的真实状态；最初，买方仅知道各种可能状态之间的先验概率分布。卖方通过发送信号来提供免费和付费信息，这些信号的状态依赖性分布会根据贝叶斯定理影响买方的后验概率分布。买方的效用函数取决于其后的后验概率分布。最优的免费信息应能使卖方从后续的付费信息销售中获得的预期收入达到最大化——这一收入等于买方在从免费信息引导的后验概率分布转变为付费信息引导的后验概率分布时所期望的效用增益。

本文详细阐述了最优免费信息和付费信息的构成，并推导出了基于买方效用函数的最大收入计算公式。研究结果表明，卖方通过提供免费信息所获得的收入增加，必然伴随着买方效用的减少。免费信息是否能够提升卖方的收入，取...。研究方法：贝叶斯方法。

papers.title: Which Policy Works, and Where? Estimation and Inference for State-Level Treatment Effects in Difference-in-Differences
papers.abstract: Policies with a common objective and implementation date may differ in details or context. We distinguish the aggregate average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) from sub-aggregate ATTs defined by implementation cohort, jurisdiction, period, or policy type. UN-DID and DID-INT, two DiD estimators that construct jurisdiction-by-time effects, estimate these ATTs under parallel-trends conditions matched to the aggregation. In CPS placebo-law simulations, randomization inference is generally well-sized, though some jurisdiction-specific tests are conservative. The jackknife can be undefined for sub-aggregate ATTs; when defined, it over-rejects with few treated or comparison jurisdictions. Estimands and inference methods should match the policy question and implementation setting.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】具有共同目标及实施日期的政策在具体细节或适用背景上可能存在差异。我们区分了针对受处理群体的总体平均处理效应（Aggregate Average Treatment Effect, ATT），以及根据实施群体、管辖范围、时间段或政策类型划分的子总体平均处理效应（sub-aggregate ATTs）。UN-DID和DID-INT这两种双重差分（DiD）估计方法能够构建按时间划分的管辖范围效应，并在符合总体汇总要求的平行趋势条件下对这些效应进行估计。在CPS（Consumer Price Survey）的安慰剂对照组模拟中，随机化推断的样本量通常较为充足，尽管某些针对特定管辖范围的检验结果可能较为保守。对于子总体平均处理效应，Jackknife方法可能无法适用；即便可以应用，该方法在受处理群体或对照组管辖范围较少的情况下也容易产生过度拒绝（即错误地拒绝零假设）的情况。估计量及推断方法应与研究问题及政策实施环境相匹配。。研究方法：双重差分、数值模拟。

papers.title: Adaptive singular-point method for pricing and hedging surrenderable equity-linked contracts
papers.abstract: We propose a deterministic numerical method for pricing and hedging surrenderable equity-linked life-insurance contracts with periodic premiums and fund contributions, maturity and death guarantees, and Bermudan surrender under correlated stochastic volatility and stochastic interest rates. The main computational challenge is the non-recombining accumulated fund, which couples with multiple stochastic factors and early exercise. Our key idea is to avoid a full multidimensional fund lattice: variance and interest-rate factors are discretized on recombining lattices, while at each factor node the contract value is represented as an adaptive one-dimensional function of the fund. Periodic contributions then act as translations of the fund argument, whereas surrender is handled directly through a backward obstacle condition. Piecewise-cubic representations propagate payoff and exercise singularities and are compressed by continuous pruning criteria that control the representation error. We establish weak convergence of the financial chains, convergence of the adaptive valuation under vanishing representation error, and Delta consistency on regular fund regions. For the strict binomial scheme, additional regularity yields first-order weak accuracy and a Talay-Tubaro expansion supporting Richardson extrapolation. Numerical experiments show compact representations, favorable cost--accuracy, and close agreement with independent Monte Carlo and cross-fitted least-squares Monte Carlo benchmarks. Hedging results further show that contracts with similar values can generate materially different exposures to equity, volatility, and interest-rate risk.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们提出了一种确定性数值方法，用于定价和对冲具有定期保费和资金投入、到期及死亡保障条款的、可提前退保的权益链接型人寿保险合同。这些合同在随机波动率和随机利率相关的情况下进行交易。主要的计算挑战在于非重组型累积资金结构，该结构与多个随机因素及提前行权行为密切相关。我们的核心思想是避免使用完整的多维资金网格：方差和利率因素被离散化到可重组的网格上，而在每个因素节点处，合同价值被表示为资金水平的一个自适应一维函数。定期资金投入通过改变资金参数来实现，而提前退保则通过反向障碍条件直接处理。分段三次函数表示法能够传递支付和行权时的奇异性，并通过连续的剪枝规则来控制表示误差。我们证明了金融链的弱收敛性、在表示误差趋近于零时的自适应估值收敛性，以及在常规资金区域内的Delta一致性。对于严格二项式模型，额外的规则性条件进一步确保了一阶弱精度，并支持使用Talay-Tubaro展开式进行Richardson外推。数值实验表明，该方法能够实现紧凑的表示形式、良好的成本-精度平衡，并且与独立的蒙特卡洛模拟结果及交叉拟合的最小二乘蒙特卡洛模拟结果高度吻合。对冲分析进一步显示，即使合同价值相似，它们对股...。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、实验方法、随机过程。

papers.title: AI and the Economy: An Economic Examination of Production, Distribution, Firms, Labor, and Welfare
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming economic systems by altering production processes, labor markets, and the structure of firms and industries. AI is not merely a technological innovation. It is fundamentally a major economic phenomenon and a new wave of innovation with important implications for productivity, employment, market structure, public policy, long-run economic growth, and collective welfare. This essay examines the economics of AI by analyzing the multiple channels through which AI influences economic activity and societal well-being. It argues that AI should be understood simultaneously as a form of capital, a form of synthetic labor, a general-purpose technology, as well as an economic infrastructure. The analysis shows that AI functions as a multi-channel engine of productivity growth through automation, augmentation, optimization, prediction, and innovation. It is argued that AI has the potential to increase output, reduce costs, stimulate entrepreneurship, and accelerate economic growth, while also reshaping labor markets through labor substitution, labor complementarity, and creative destruction. The essay further examines AI's effects on competition, market concentration, and entrepreneurship. Finally, it explores the welfare implications of AI for consumers, producers, workers, governments, and society as a whole, and concludes by outlining policy considerations aimed at maximizing the benefits of AI while mitigating its potential adverse consequences.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】人工智能（AI）正在通过改变生产流程、劳动力市场以及企业和行业的结构，迅速重塑经济体系。AI不仅仅是一项技术创新，从根本上说，它是一种重大的经济现象，代表着新一轮的创新浪潮，对生产力、就业、市场结构、公共政策、长期经济增长和整体福利都具有重要影响。本文通过分析AI影响经济活动和社会福祉的多种途径，探讨了AI的经济学本质。文章认为，应将AI视为一种资本形式、一种合成劳动力、一种通用技术，同时也是一种经济基础设施。研究表明，AI通过自动化、辅助作用、优化、预测和创新等多种渠道推动生产力增长。AI有潜力提高产出、降低成本、激发创业活动并加速经济增长，同时通过劳动力替代、劳动力互补和创造性破坏等方式重塑劳动力市场。文章进一步分析了AI对竞争、市场集中度和创业的影响。最后，探讨了AI对消费者、生产者、工人、政府以及整个社会的福利影响，并提出了旨在最大化AI效益同时减轻其潜在负面影响的政策建议。。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Harvesting the Variance Risk Premium in Nuclear and Energy Equities: A Short-Put Portfolio Derisking Strategy
papers.abstract: We study whether nuclear and energy-adjacent equity options exhibit a harvestable variance risk premium. Using CRSP and OptionMetrics data for 2000-2024, we construct a systematic cash-secured short-put strategy on a curated universe of nuclear-related firms. The strategy compares at-the-money put implied volatility with GARCH-based realized volatility forecasts, then evaluates unconditional and IV/RV-filtered put-writing portfolios. The results show positive average option premia, high win rates, and substantially lower volatility than an equal-weight stock benchmark, though performance is measured before transaction costs and with a fixed universe.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们研究了核能及相关能源行业的股票期权是否具有可利用的方差风险溢价。利用CRSP和OptionMetrics数据库中2000至2024年的数据，我们针对一组精选的核能相关企业构建了一种系统性现金担保的卖空策略。该策略将平价看跌期权的隐含波动率与基于GARCH模型的实际波动率预测进行比较，随后评估了无条件条件下的期权组合以及经过IV/RV过滤后的期权组合表现。研究结果表明：这些期权组合的平均溢价为正，胜率较高，且波动率显著低于等权重股票基准组合；不过这些结果是在未考虑交易成本且样本范围固定的情况下得出的。。研究方法：GARCH 波动率模型。

papers.title:
The Impact of Government Environmental Auditing on Corporate
 ESG
 Greenwashing
papers.abstract: Government environmental auditing, as a critical tool for regulating corporate behaviour and promoting market green transformation, exerts a substantial influence in mitigating corporate ESG greenwashing practices. Focusing on A‐share listed corporations in China during the period 2009–2023, this analysis utilises a double machine learning approach to investigate the causal effects and internal mechanisms of government environmental auditing on corporate ESG greenwashing. The analysis indicates that: (1) Government environmental auditing exerts a significant inhibitory effect on corporate ESG greenwashing. This remains valid after rigorous testing. (2) Heterogeneity tests show that this inhibitory effect is stronger in state‐owned enterprises, heavily polluting corporations and large‐scale corporations. (3) In terms of mechanisms, government environmental auditing reduces corporate information disclosure catering, optimises green investment allocation and regulates earnings management activities and inefficient investments, thereby curbing corporate ESG greenwashing.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】政府环境审计作为规范企业行为、推动市场绿色转型的重要工具，在遏制企业ESG（环境、社会和治理）漂绿行为方面发挥着重要作用。本研究以2009年至2023年间在中国上市的A股企业为研究对象，采用双重机器学习方法探讨了政府环境审计对企业ESG漂绿的因果效应及其内在机制。研究结果表明：（1）政府环境审计对企业ESG漂绿行为具有显著的抑制作用，这一结论在经过严格检验后依然成立；（2）异质性分析显示，这种抑制作用在国有企业、高污染企业以及大型企业中更为显著；（3）从机制层面来看，政府环境审计通过减少企业信息披露、优化绿色投资配置、规范盈余管理行为及抑制低效投资，从而有效遏制了企业的ESG漂绿行为。。研究方法：机器学习。

papers.title: Asymmetric Long‐Run Effects of Monetary Policy on Generational Inequality
papers.abstract:
This paper investigates the asymmetric long‐run effects of reversing contractionary monetary policy to expansionary policy on generational inequality in the UK using non‐linear autoregressive distributed lag (NARDL). The results show that there exists a long‐term relationship between monetary policy and income, consumption, and wealth inequality. This study finds that contractionary monetary policy is more likely to have a more pronounced impact on inequality than expansionary monetary policy. A decision by the central bank to change a contractionary policy to an expansionary policy may not necessarily reverse the negative impact caused by the former. These findings imply that policymakers should account for the persistent and asymmetric distributional consequences of monetary tightening, particularly its disproportionate burden on younger cohorts. Monetary authorities may therefore need to complement contractionary measures with targeted macroprudential interventions to mitigate long‐lasting inequality effects and avoid intergenerational disparities becoming entrenched.

papers.title: An Empirical Study of the Effect of Entrepreneurial Social Capital on the Mobilization of Financial Resources: The Case of Moroccan SMEs
papers.venue: International Journal of Research in Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: This research study investigates the links between an entrepreneur’s social capital and access to financial resources. Using a conceptual framework derived from the theoretical and empirical literature on social capital in the field of entrepreneurship, our research aims to identify the aspects of social capital that can facilitate access to these resources, taking into account the moderating effects of market uncertainty on this relationship. A questionnaire survey of 41 Moroccan SMEs allowed us to operationalize the dimensions of social capital and to test their influence on access to financial resources. The results of the research show that social capital has some influence on access to financial resources, particularly the two variables “size” and “diversity” of the entrepreneur’s relational network. On the other hand, our study reveals that environmental uncertainty does not have a moderating effect on this relationship.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究探讨了企业家社会资本与获取金融资源之间的关联。基于创业领域关于社会资本的理论与实证文献，我们构建了一个概念框架，旨在识别那些能够促进企业获取金融资源的社交资本要素，并考虑市场不确定性在这一关系中的调节作用。通过对41家摩洛哥中小企业的问卷调查，我们量化了社会资本的各个维度，并检验了它们对获取金融资源的影响。研究结果表明，社会资本确实对获取金融资源具有影响，尤其是企业家关系网络中的“规模”和“多样性”这两个变量。另一方面，研究发现市场不确定性并未对这一关系产生调节作用。。研究方法：调查数据。
